{{Quote|It was all this silvery black, like a Naboo night pearl.|Herren|<ref name="Philanthropy">{{LivingForce|Below the Belt: Philanthropy}}</ref>}}
A '''Naboo night pearl''' was a type of black-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Pearl/Legends|pearl]]. During the [[Confederation Rock Rush]], the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Daring (transport)|''Daring'']] collided with an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]], and [[Herren]]&mdash;the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] first mate&mdash;compared the color of the asteroid to that of a [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] night pearl.
